alertId.description: Alphanumeric characters generated on the creation of the alert.

name.description: Some text assigning a name to the alert.

description.description: Some text describing the purpose of the alert.

iataCarrierCode.description: A two-character code assigned by the IATA to international airlines. Optional unless updating an alert to alertType "Carrier", in which case iataCarrierCode and/or icaoCarrierCode must be supplied.

icaoCarrierCode.description: A three-character code assigned by the ICAO to international airlines. Optional unless updating an alert to alertType "Carrier", in which case iataCarrierCode and/or icaoCarrierCode must be supplied.

flightNumber.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

fromFlight.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

toFlight.description: A numeric part (up to four digits) of a flight designator.

departureAirport.description: A Three-letter code assigned by the IATA to an airport location representing the departure airport. Optional unless updating an alert to alertType "Port", in which case departureAirport and/or arrivalAirport must be supplied.

arrivalAirport.description: A Three-letter code assigned by the IATA to an airport location representing the arrival airport. Optional unless creating an alert to alertType "Port", in which case departureAirport and/or arrivalAirport must be supplied.

alertType.description: The type of alert being configured. Accepted values are "Global", "Carrier" or "Port".

active.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the alert.

content.description: If the string "seats, changeindicator" is specified, seat and change indicator data will be included in the alert output.

departureDate.description: A date in the format yyyy-MM-dd for flight departures.

arrivalDate.description: A date in the format yyyy-MM-dd for flight arrivals.

schedules.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of schedules flight updates in the event feed.

status.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of status flight updates in the event feed.

gaFlights.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of GA flight updates in the event feed.

unscheduledFlights.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of unscheduled flight updates in the event feed.

codeshare.description: A true/false value to enable/disable the inclusion of marketing flight updates in the event feed. Defaults to true.

estimatedArrivalTimeThreshold.description: Positive or negative threshold for estimated arrival time.

estimatedDepartureTimeThreshold.description: Positive or negative threshold for estimated departure time.

statusChangeFilters.baggage.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in baggage.

statusChangeFilters.aircraftRegistration.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in aircraftRegistrationNumber.

statusChangeFilters.gates.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in gates.

statusChangeFilters.terminal.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in terminal.

statusChangeFilters.seats.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in seats.

statusChangeFilters.aircraftType.description: If value is "false", will ignore flight updates that only have a change in aircraftType.
